about_the_game:
Flyra brings the thrill of FPV drone flight to your screen with a blend of speed, skill, and freedom. Designed for both newcomers and experienced pilots, Flyra captures the rush of flying through realistic physics and diverse environments.

Take control, learn the basics, or push your reflexes to the limit as you race, freestyle, and survive in high-intensity challenges. Whether you're chasing checkpoints, pulling off stunts, or dodging obstacles, every flight delivers the excitement of true FPV.

✨ Game Modes

🎯 Racing Mode
Compete at high speeds through thrilling tracks and tight turns. Perfect your racing lines and chase the ultimate lap time.
🌀 Freestyle Mode
Unleash your creativity in wide-open environments like cityscapes and industrial zones. Perform flips, rolls, and cinematic maneuvers to showcase your flying style.
🔥 Mission Mode
Test your endurance against hazards and obstacles. Stay in the air as long as you can — every second counts.

🚁 Key Features
Beginner-friendly controls that ease you into FPV flying.
Realistic drone physics for an authentic experience.
Multiple drone models to choose from, each with a unique feel.
Diverse environments: factories, cities, tunnels, and more.
Fast-paced action or smooth cinematic stunts — the choice is yours.
Optimized for both newcomers and skilled FPV pilots.
Full FPV controller support, Mouse and keyboard support, Joystick support, Console controller support.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 580 / AMD HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 GB available space

short_description: Flyra is a high-speed FPV drone simulator with Racing, Freestyle, and Survival challenges. Test your reflexes, explore unique environments, and fly a range of drones with realistic physics. Discover the thrill of flying free.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support
